scores.evidence: On Linux use `renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE)`, on macOS `renamex_np(RENAME_EXCL)`, and elsewhere fall back to `link` + `unlink`.
scores.rationale: No-clobber primitives, Windows rename semantics, QuickTime UTC quirk and EXIF having no timezone are all accurate; small imprecision is the sidecar stem assumption and the `--` exiftool claim.

scores.evidence: A unit = the primary image plus any same-stem siblings (`.xmp`, `.aae`, Live Photo `.mov`), renamed together.
scores.rationale: Covers the real need (safe rename, collisions, sidecars, skips) with explicit deferrals, though configurable templates are postponed.

scores.evidence: Single CLI process, with an internal `core` package (planner, validator, renamer) kept separate from the `cli` layer.
scores.rationale: Clear unit, plan, validate, journal, apply flow; small loose ends: no-clobber is said to be in Phase 0 but built in Phase 1, and 'never convert' conflicts with the QuickTime UTC conversion.

scores.evidence: A property-based test (Hypothesis) ... apply then undo must give a byte-identical hash manifest, and no file may ever be lost.
scores.rationale: Property tests, fault injection, golden corpus under two TZs, and 3-OS CI target the real risks; the 10k/30s targets are invented and date-source risk is validated after safety work.

scores.evidence: Users merge photos from several cameras across timezones. Then add opt-in `--normalize-utc`
scores.rationale: Each key default has a revisit trigger, but scale and user assumptions (single user, 10k files) are not stated explicitly and thresholds are unjustified.

scores.evidence: Validator: ... detect case-insensitive collisions (NTFS, APFS, SMB shares); reject any target that would resolve outside the source directory.
scores.rationale: Covers overwrite, swaps, crash and kill -9 recovery, corrupt or crafted metadata, option injection and sidecar separation; it misses undo when files changed after the run, disk full and concurrent runs.

scores.evidence: documented exit codes: 0 ok, 1 completed with skips, 2 usage error, 3 environment error ... 5 apply failed partway with journal written
scores.rationale: Exit codes, counters, CI smoke, doctor, release and journal versioning suit a local CLI; there is no field telemetry, and support and ownership are thin.

scores.evidence: Dominant constraint: Correctness, and specifically not losing data. Speed matters much less.
scores.rationale: Costs are near zero for a local tool and buy-vs-build is noted, but there is no explicit treatment of engineering effort or CI costs.

scores.evidence: Filename contract (the most expensive decision to reverse) ... Once people's libraries are renamed, changing the default breaks their workflows.
scores.rationale: Identifies the filename contract, unit model, journal format and JSON schema as one-way, freezes them deliberately, isolates the metadata reader behind an interface, and defers reversible options.

scores.evidence: PyPI trusted publishing with signed artifacts. ... an SBOM, and a dependency audit (`pip-audit`) in CI.
scores.rationale: The core is a lean single process with no database or service, but SBOM, reproducible wheels, man page, doctor, debug-report and the five-phase process are heavy for a small CLI.

scores.evidence: `photoname ./fixtures/single --apply` ... the file becomes `2024-07-14_153012.JPG`, a journal file ... is written
scores.rationale: A concrete first slice, dependency-ordered phases with checkable exit criteria, and stated revisit triggers mean a team could start immediately.

checklist.evidence: Skip the file and report why. Never fall back to file mtime silently
Collisions get `_01`, `_02`… in a fixed order: sub-second time, then original name.
Dry run is the default; `--apply` is required to change anything.
every unit first gets a unique temporary name ... then its final name. This handles swaps and cycles
Use the wall-clock time exactly as recorded (EXIF `DateTimeOriginal` has no timezone). Never convert to the host's local time.
A unit = the primary image plus any same-stem siblings (`.xmp`, `.aae`, Live Photo `.mov`), renamed together.
`YYYY-MM-DD_HHMMSS.ext`. The original extension is kept exactly, case included.

traps.evidence: Make the rename itself no-clobber on every OS.
Never fall back to file mtime silently, because copying files resets mtime.
Single CLI process ... A service split never applies.
Deferred: Deduplication, writing EXIF data, watch mode, GUI.

note: A strong, safety-first plan with correct no-clobber, undo and sidecar handling and no listed traps; it loses points for ceremony in later phases, thin cost reasoning, and deferred templates.
